logger.doc:name: Log start
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "Integration request " ++ (vars.requestId default "?") ++ " type=" ++ (vars.req.requestType default "?") ++ " source=" ++ (vars.opportunityId default "?")]

logger.doc:name: Unknown request
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "No Integration_Transaction__c row for request " ++ vars.requestId ++ "; ignoring"]

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { outcome: 'IGNORED_UNKNOWN_REQUEST', message: 'Registry row not found' }]

when.expression: #[vars.registry.external.key != null or !((p('provisioning.processableStatuses') splitBy ',') map trim($) contains (vars.registry.requestStatus default ''))]

logger.doc:name: Already processed
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "Request " ++ vars.requestId ++ " already processed (status " ++ (vars.registry.requestStatus default "?") ++ ", key " ++ (vars.registry.external.key default "none") ++ "); skipping"]

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { outcome: 'SKIPPED_ALREADY_PROCESSED', issueKey: vars.registry.external.key, message: 'Registry status ' ++ (vars.registry.requestStatus default '') }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json skipNullOn="everywhere" --- { requestId: vars.requestId } ++ vars.outcome

logger.doc:name: Existing key
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "Opportunity " ++ vars.opportunityId ++ " already has Jira key " ++ vars.opp.jiraSetupIssueKey ++ "; cancelling request " ++ vars.requestId]

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { outcome: 'CREATED', issueKey: vars.issue.key, issueUrl: vars.issue.url, attempts: vars.attempt }]

when.expression: #[vars.line.project == null or vars.line.project == 'TBD' or vars.line.issueType == null or vars.line.instanceField == null]

raise-error.doc:name: Unsupported line
raise-error.description: #['No Jira target configured for product line \'' ++ vars.line.salesforceValue ++ '\' (deactivation.lines.' ++ vars.line.code ++ '). Re-drive this request once the Jira project exists.']

raise-error.doc:name: Missing instance id
raise-error.description: #['No ' ++ vars.line.instanceLabel ++ ' on Account ' ++ (vars.opp.account.name default vars.opp.account.id default '?') ++ ' for product line ' ++ vars.line.salesforceValue]

choice.doc:name: C. Opportunity already keyed for this line?

logger.doc:name: Existing key
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "Opportunity " ++ vars.opportunityId ++ " already has deactivation key " ++ vars.line.existingKey ++ " for " ++ vars.line.salesforceValue ++ "; cancelling request " ++ vars.requestId]

logger.doc:name: Link existing
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "Jira already has " ++ vars.existingIssue.key ++ " labelled " ++ vars.line.label ++ "; linking it to request " ++ vars.requestId ++ " instead of creating a duplicate"]

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { key: vars.existingIssue.key, id: vars.existingIssue.id, url: vars.existingIssue.url, linked: true }]
set-variable.doc:name: issue (linked)

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { project: vars.line.project, issueType: vars.line.issueType, labels: vars.line.tags }]
set-variable.doc:name: ticket (reference only)

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { outcome: 'LINKED_EXISTING_TICKET', issueKey: vars.issue.key, issueUrl: vars.issue.url, attempts: vars.attempt, message: 'Existing Jira ticket linked by label ' ++ vars.line.label }]
#[output application/java --- { outcome: 'CREATED', issueKey: vars.issue.key, issueUrl: vars.issue.url, attempts: vars.attempt }]

logger.doc:name: Log line
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "Request " ++ vars.requestId ++ " product line " ++ vars.line.code ++ " -> " ++ (vars.line.project default "unconfigured") ++ "/" ++ (vars.line.issueType default "?") ++ ", instance " ++ (vars.line.instanceId default "none")]

logger.doc:name: Done tickets ignored
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "Label " ++ vars.line.label ++ " matches only Done ticket(s) " ++ ((payload map $.key) joinBy ", ") ++ "; a new ticket will be created"]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import * from modules::TicketMapping output application/java var mapping = readUrl("classpath://" ++ p('deactivation.mappingFile'), "application/yaml") var ctx = { opp: vars.opp, req: vars.req, registry: vars.registry, line: vars.line, env: { jiraProject: p('jira.project') }, sfUrl: p('sf.baseUrl') ++ "/" ++ (vars.opp.id default "") } --- buildTicket(mapping, ctx)

logger.doc:name: Log ticket
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "Deactivation ticket for request " ++ vars.requestId ++ ": " ++ write(vars.ticket - "description", "application/json")]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import * from modules::TicketMapping output application/java var mapping = readUrl("classpath://" ++ p('provisioning.mappingFile'), "application/yaml") var ctx = { opp: vars.opp, req: vars.req, registry: vars.registry, env: { jiraProject: p('jira.project') }, sfUrl: p('sf.baseUrl') ++ "/" ++ (vars.opp.id default "") } --- buildTicket(mapping, ctx)

logger.doc:name: Status read failed
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "Could not read initial status of " ++ vars.issueKey ++ ": " ++ (error.description default "")]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import try from dw::Runtime output application/java var st = vars.issueStatus var typeCode = (vars.ticket.issueType default "SYSTEM_SETUP") as String // Display name of the issue type for External_Type__c (config jira.issueTypeNames.<CODE>; the code itself as fallback) var typeName = do { var r = try(() -> p('jira.issueTypeNames.' ++ typeCode)) --- if (r.success and r.result != null) r.result else typeCode } --- { requestStatus: "Created", attempts: vars.attempt, lastError: null, errorCategory: null, muleCorrelationId: correlationId, requestPayload: if (vars.ticket == null) null else write(vars.ticket, "application/json"), responsePayload: write(vars.issue, "application/json"), // Scenario 2: stamp the resolved line so the write-back Flow can route the row even if the publisher left Product_Line__c blank (productLine: vars.line.salesforceValue) if (vars.line.salesforceValue != null), external: { key: vars.issue.key, id: vars.issue.id, url: vars.issue.url, container: vars.ticket.project, "type": typeName, status: st.name default "Open", statusId: st.id, statusCategory: p('jira.statusCategoryMap.' ++ (st.category default "new")), statusChangedAt: now(), lastSyncedAt: now() } }

set-variable.doc:name: patch: Cancelled
set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { requestStatus: 'Cancelled', attempts: vars.attempt, lastError: 'Opportunity already has Jira key ' ++ vars.existingKey, errorCategory: 'Terminal', muleCorrelationId: correlationId, (productLine: vars.line.salesforceValue) if (vars.line.salesforceValue != null), external: { key: vars.existingKey } }]
#[output application/java --- { outcome: 'SKIPPED_EXISTING_KEY', issueKey: vars.existingKey, attempts: vars.attempt }]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import * from modules::TicketMapping output application/java --- classify(error)

logger.doc:name: Log failure
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "Integration request " ++ vars.requestId ++ " attempt " ++ (vars.attempt as String) ++ " failed (" ++ (if (vars.failure.retryable) "transient" else "terminal") ++ ", " ++ vars.failure.code ++ "): " ++ vars.failure.message]

set-variable.doc:name: patch: exhausted
set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { requestStatus: 'Failed - Terminal', attempts: vars.attempt, lastError: 'Retries exhausted after ' ++ (vars.attempt as String) ++ ' attempts. Last error: ' ++ vars.failure.message, errorCategory: 'Transient', muleCorrelationId: correlationId, responsePayload: if (vars.failure.detail == null) null else write(vars.failure.detail, 'application/json') }]
#[output application/java --- { outcome: 'RETRIES_EXHAUSTED', attempts: vars.attempt, message: vars.failure.message }]

set-variable.doc:name: patch: terminal
set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { requestStatus: 'Failed - Terminal', attempts: vars.attempt, lastError: vars.failure.code ++ ': ' ++ vars.failure.message, errorCategory: vars.failure.category, muleCorrelationId: correlationId, requestPayload: if (vars.ticket == null) null else write(vars.ticket, 'application/json'), responsePayload: if (vars.failure.detail == null) null else write(vars.failure.detail, 'application/json') }]
#[output application/java --- { outcome: 'TERMINAL_ERROR', attempts: vars.attempt, message: vars.failure.code ++ ': ' ++ vars.failure.message }]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import * from modules::TicketMapping output application/java --- now() + ("PT" ++ (backoffSeconds(vars.attempt, p('provisioning.retry.baseDelaySeconds') as Number, p('provisioning.retry.maxDelaySeconds') as Number) as String) ++ "S") as Period

set-variable.doc:name: patch: Retrying
set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { requestStatus: 'Retrying', attempts: vars.attempt, lastError: vars.failure.code ++ ': ' ++ vars.failure.message ++ ' (next attempt ' ++ (vars.nextAttemptAt as String) ++ ')', errorCategory: 'Transient', muleCorrelationId: correlationId }]

os:store.doc:name: Park in retry store
os:store.os:value: #[output application/json --- { requestId: vars.requestId, attempt: vars.attempt, nextAttemptAt: vars.nextAttemptAt, lastError: vars.failure.message, request: vars.req }]

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { outcome: 'RETRY_SCHEDULED', attempts: vars.attempt, message: vars.failure.message ++ '; next attempt at ' ++ (vars.nextAttemptAt as String) }]
